title: Fuel Extra
description: Adds 4 more items and 1 more block that can be used as fuel.
body:
This mod adds 4 more Items and 1 more block to be used as fuel.

8-Pack Sticks: crafted with 8 sticks and smelts 4.25 items.

charged coal: crafted with 1 coal and 4 blaze rods and smelts 64 items.

charged lava: crafted with 1 lava bucket and 4 blaze rods and smelts 160 items.

dense coal block: crafted with 9 coal blocks and smelts 800 items.

wooden drab: crafted with 6 hay bales and 3 logs and smelts 22 items.
